name: cc-redacted
description: Takes identifying details out of what Claude is sent (email, environment, model, memory paths, chosen sections and reminders, literal strings), for experiment runs that need a clean context

dropContext.title: Context blocks to leave out
dropContext.description: Comma-separated names of first-message context blocks: userEmail, claudeMd, attachedProject, currentDate

dropSections.title: System prompt sections to leave out
dropSections.description: Comma-separated section ids, such as env_info, env_info_simple, memory, total_tokens

dropReminders.title: Reminder types to leave out
dropReminders.description: Comma-separated attachment types, such as environment, model, date, remote_session_change (the commit attribution, which names the model), total_tokens_reminder

scrub.title: Literal replacements
scrub.description: find=>replace pairs separated by |, applied to every section, context block, reminder and tool description that is still sent

autoScrub.title: Scrub home folder, user name and email
autoScrub.description: Also replace the home folder with ~, the account user name with 'user' and the email with user@example.com wherever they still appear

auditFile.title: Audit file
auditFile.description: Absolute path of a file listing everything this mod left out or replaced; empty means none
